methodology.oracle: Known clean RGB backgrounds with separately rasterized glyph alpha, Hiragino/Arial/Apple SD Gothic at 3x and Lanczos reduced. Not dataset accuracy.
methodology.conditions: Three scripts, 16/24/36 px, light/dark/pastel/equal-luma/faint/muted backgrounds, linear gradients, colored outer strokes.
methodology.metric: Observed glyph pixels (alpha >=32 and source/clean RGB separation >=12) require >=99% erasure coverage and reconstruction MAE <=5. Color maximum channel error <=25. Outside-mask pixels immutable.
